title: A&C Agent Skill Frontmatter
description: The frontmatter of an Agent Skill (a SKILL.md file inside its own folder). Skills follow the open Agent Skills format instead of the A&C documentation contract, so assistants such as Claude can load them unchanged. The rules are the union of the Agent Skills specification (agentskills.io/specification) and Claude's stricter limits (no reserved words in name, no XML in description). The validator additionally checks, in code, that name equals the skill's folder name.

name.description: Skill identifier: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, no leading or trailing hyphen, without the reserved words 'anthropic' or 'claude'. Must equal the skill's folder name.

description.description: What the skill covers and when to use it; assistants decide whether to load the skill from this text alone. Non-blank, no '<' or '>'.

license.description: License name or reference to a bundled license file.

compatibility.description: Environment requirements, only when the skill has them.

metadata.description: Additional properties not defined by the Agent Skills format, as string keys and string values.

allowed-tools.description: Space-separated tools pre-approved to run (experimental in the Agent Skills format).
